answer: An operator running 144 keys thus pays for 144 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the inlet quota and the grove admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the onyx ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
